Oneliner

Further develop and demonstrate the Exo-Brake system through full recovery of a payload.
Results

Both versions of the BrainStack payload produced partially successful results; it was confirmed the TX2 payload activated, recorded a video, compressed the file, and wirelessly transferred the data to the S-band radio via Wi-Fi, determined through event logs and verified onboard file transfers. Unfortunately, in both cases the Lunar Radio did not perform as expected, preventing recovery of the full video file as an S-band downlink was never successfully maintained. 
Failure cause Power system anomaly
